messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a handful of tenants showing negative 'remaining tokens' in the console after last night's routing policy rollout. Not a UI-only glitch, looks like some token ledger rows were double-attributed.
ajay: ugh. any pattern on which routes or models?
maya: mostly requests that hit fallback routing (model_alias -> model_legacy) during capacity shed. The routing proxy retried and we ended up emitting two meter events for the same request id.
sophie: which field are we deduping on? request_id or fingerprint?
maya: our current consumer dedup key is (client_id, request_id). The proxy sometimes clones request_id when it retries downstream, so dedupe fails.
oliver: can we use an idempotency header from the edge? iirc edge adds x-rid but proxy overrides on retry.
ajay: quick mitigation: we can add best-effort dedupe in postproc by hashing (client_id, route, timestamp_window, input_digest). not perfect but reduces doubles.
sophie: i worry about changing postproc before understanding fallout on invoices. If we drop duplicates we need safe audit trail.
maya: agreed. proposal: 1) quick patch to postproc to coalesce likely duplicates for 24h window (canary 5% tenants) 2) run a reconciliation job to correct ledger rows and attach audit tags 3) dashboard flag to show flagged duplicate events so CS can triage invoices.
ajay: ok for canary but we should also add a temporary console annotation: add a banner "Billing events for some requests may be double-counted while routing rollback in progress". saves support noise.
oliver: deploy-bot: Canary rollout queued: service=metering-postproc percent=5 owner=@ajay ETA=35m :rocket:
sophie: SQL snippet I used to find candidates:```SELECT client_id, request_id, count(*) as n, array_agg(id) ids FROM meter_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '48 hours' GROUP BY client_id, request_id HAVING count(*) > 1;```
maya: thanks. will run on staging and produce sample CSV for ledger team.
ajay: timeline? if we ship the coalesce patch in next 2h we can start canary and recon overnight.
sophie: make sure to tag affected invoice previews with "metering-investigation" so customers on the free tier don't freak.
maya: noted. I'll open a small runbook in ops (link in thread) and post the CSV when ready.
oliver: follow-up: we should add a deterministic id at the proxy level so retried paths preserve idempotency. I'll file an RFC after this incident.
ajay: +1 on RFC. For now, proceed with the 5% canary + dashboard banner. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks everyone — I'll message billing and cs and coordinate the recon job.
